slides.title: QP07 metabolic kinase: potency and selectivity
Plate acceptance and study record
bullets: Study 06 Apr–18 May 2001; interim discussion 27 Apr 2001.
Screening set: {{PRJ0032:n_compounds}} aminopyrazines; sample cards under {{PRJ0032:lims_id}}.
Ines Alvarado checked plate controls and run-sheet transcription before release.
Martin Ellerscombe checked concentration-response fits; Bethany Rowcroft released the screening interpretation.

slides.title: Assay basis for ranking
bullets: Primary potency assay against the metabolic-signal kinase; IC50 reported in nM.
Selectivity sweep at 1 µM for the representatives listed in the panel.
Read potency alongside Hill slope; a fitted value is not a binding mechanism.
Compare off-target inhibition at the stated concentration separately from primary potency.

slides.notes: Representative structures identify the screening set; this grid is not a potency ranking.

slides.title: Combined screen interpretation
bullets: The primary potency ranking survived the selectivity counterscreen.
The compact heteroaryl subset provides the progression route; do not rank the set on potency alone.
The panel is a fingerprint at 1 µM, not a complete off-target concentration-response assessment.

slides.title: Quorenthel screen gate and next test lot
bullets: Progress the compact heteroaryl subset selected from the combined listings.
Retain sample-card compound identifiers when requesting replacement material.
Confirm primary potency on the next test lot and use the same panel concentration for comparison.
Bethany Rowcroft to issue the biology memo with final run-sheet references; broader selectivity remains follow-up work.
